projects.name: Solar + Energy Storage on Garage
projects.description: Install 5-7 solar panels on south-facing garage roof face (20x12 ft, ~2-2.8 kW) plus battery storage. Solar = standalone ROI investment (~5yr payback at $0.42/kWh). Battery = generator alternative (no lot space for generator). 30% federal ITC applies to both when paired.
projects.notes: DESIGN: South garage face only. 5 portrait panels = 2.0 kW; 7 mixed = 2.8 kW. ~3,200-4,500 kWh/yr production (20-26% offset). All-in after ITC: solar ~$9-10k, battery ~$9-10k. VENDORS: Sunergy (sunergy.com) — EnergySage 2026 CA Installer of Year, Enphase Platinum, no door-to-door. NRG Clean Power (nrgcleanpower.com) — Diamond Certified, 35yr, San Mateo County, 40yr warranty. Tesla Energy (tesla.com/energy) — online only. AVOID: Sunrun.

tasks.title: Analyze energy usage and size system
tasks.notes: 17,178 kWh/yr at $0.42/kWh avg. Target: 5-7 panels south garage face (20x12 ft) = 2-2.8 kW. ~5yr payback after ITC.

tasks.title: Research and shortlist solar installers
tasks.notes: Shortlist: Sunergy (sunergy.com, Enphase Platinum, no door-to-door), NRG Clean Power (nrgcleanpower.com, Diamond Certified, San Mateo County), Tesla Energy (tesla.com/energy, online only). Avoid Sunrun.

tasks.title: Contact installers for quotes
tasks.notes: Spec: south garage face (20x12 ft, 5-7 panels, ~2-2.8 kW), paired battery (Enphase IQ or Powerwall 3), detached garage sub-panel interconnect. Ask each for: $/W, panel brand, inverter type, battery spec, warranty, timeline, ITC total. Request free shade/LIDAR analysis.

tasks.title: Compare quotes and select installer
tasks.notes: Prefer Enphase microinverters over string inverter. Compare $/W, battery spec, warranty, timeline. 30% ITC on full system incl. battery.

tasks.title: Confirm ITC timing — credit files in year PTO is granted
tasks.notes: 30% federal ITC on Form 5695. Claimed in tax year Permission to Operate granted by PG&E. Battery qualifies only when solar-paired. Plan install timing accordingly.

insights.summary: The sustained presence of 22–27 devices paired with zero common-area camera motion at 10 PM confirms the household is fully settled indoors with everyone in private rooms, aligning with a normal Sunday night routine rather than a network glitch or security event.

The stable presence of 25–28 connected devices alongside zero camera motion over four hours indicates the household is fully settled indoors, likely in non-camera zones, with typical evening device usage. This aligns with expected Sunday night behavior and poses no security concern.

The sustained presence of 23–27 devices combined with zero camera motion over four hours strongly suggests a large gathering where occupants are either stationary (e.g., watching a movie or dining) or concentrated in an unmonitored zone like the backyard or garage. This warrants a quick camera status check to rule out offline sensors and confirms the home is actively hosting rather than empty.

The sustained presence of 22-25 devices alongside zero camera motion over four hours strongly suggests a large gathering or network anomaly, but the complete lack of camera triggers indicates either everyone is in a camera-blind zone or the cameras are offline, warranting a quick check to ensure security coverage isn't compromised.

The sustained 21-25 device count paired with zero camera motion over four hours strongly suggests a network reporting anomaly or a gathering confined to camera-blind zones, rather than typical active household activity. Verifying camera functionality and filtering IoT/hub devices from the presence count will clarify whether this is a true gathering or a false positive.

The sustained 21-26 device count paired with zero camera motion over a Sunday afternoon strongly indicates a settled indoor gathering where guests are stationary or in camera-blind zones; a quick confirmation is recommended to verify this aligns with expected visitors and rule out unauthorized network access.

The sustained presence of 25+ devices combined with zero camera motion over four hours strongly indicates a stationary gathering (e.g., movie night or board games) likely occurring in camera-blind zones or with cameras temporarily disabled. This warrants a quick check to ensure guest comfort and verify camera status.

The sustained presence of 21-28 devices combined with zero camera motion strongly suggests a gathering where occupants are congregated in a camera-blind zone or that the presence count is heavily driven by stationary IoT devices (TVs, consoles, smart displays) rather than human movement.

The sustained 17-21 device count paired with zero camera motion across all zones for over four hours on a Sunday afternoon strongly indicates the household is gathered in a single, camera-blind area or has entered prolonged inactivity, warranting a quick wellness check or camera verification to rule out sensor failure or an unresponsive situation.

The sustained high device count (peaking at 21) combined with zero motion detection across all cameras for four hours strongly suggests the camera system may be offline, misconfigured, or motion detection is disabled, as two active dogs and two pre-teens would typically trigger movement. This warrants a quick system check to ensure security monitoring is active.
